To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
digital transformation is positively related to technology entrepreneurship, which in turn is positively related to technological market expansion.

digital transformation, as a whole, has a positive effect on technology entrepreneurship and that technology readiness has the strongest impact, followed by digital technology exploration and exploitation, respectively.

digital technology exploration and exploitation have a positive and significant impact on technology entrepreneurship and digital technology exploration is positively and significantly associated with technological market expansion, while digital technology exploitation negatively and significantly associated with the same.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the impact of digital innovation on the entrepreneurial process and the role of technology readiness and exploration and exploitation in the process of technology entrepreneurship.
the impact of digital entrepreneurship on technology entrepreneurship and the impact of technology entrepreneurship on technological market expansion.
the impact of digital technology on the development of entrepreneurship and the expansion of the technological market.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

technology entrepreneurship and technological expansion are significantly affected by digital transformation and that the effect of digital transformation is more pronounced on technology entrepreneurship than technological market expansion.
the digital technology exploitation is positively associated with technology entrepreneurship, which in turn is positively associated with technological market expansion.
the digital transformation is a key driver for the development and expansion of technology entrepreneurship in the European countries.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
digital transformation is a significant factor for entrepreneurship and technology entrepreneurship, which is in turn a key factor for technological market expansion.
digital transformation has a significant effect on the development of entrepreneurship, and the impact of this relationship is mediated by technology entrepreneurship and technological expansion.
digital transformation is a key driver of digital entrepreneurship and technological market expansions, which are in turn positively related to the economic development of a nation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
digital transformation is a key driver for technology entrepreneurship and technological innovation.
digital transformation is not a one-time event but an ongoing journey.
technology readiness and digital technology exploration positively affect the entrepreneurial process and technological market expansion, whereas digital technology exploitation does not.
